onChange.script:
prevArr = [v.value for v in previousValue.value] if previousValue.value else []
    currArr = [v.value for v in currentValue.value] if currentValue.value else []
	
    # If two or more are True, keep only the one that just flipped True
    if sum(1 for c in currArr if c) > 1:
        # Find the index that changed from False -> True
        idx = next(i for i, (p, c) in enumerate(zip(prevArr, currArr)) if (not p and c))
        self.custom.checkboxAnswers = [(i == idx) for i in range(len(currArr))]

messageHandlers.script:
listCustom = [
		"answers"
	]
	
	for path in listCustom:
		self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer_Start").refreshBinding("custom.{}".format(path))
	
	
	
	listCustom = [
		"answers.formato"
	]
	for path in listCustom:
		self.view.refreshBinding("custom.{}".format(path))

	answerIT = self.view.custom.answers.formato
	
	papoID = self.view.params.papoID
	user = self.session.props.auth.user.userName
	workstationNodeID = self.view.params.workstationnodeID
	workstationID = self.view.params.workstationID
	nodeID = self.view.params.nodeID
	status = "En proceso"
	now = system.date.now()
	
	from java.lang import String
	query = """
		SELECT TOP 1 RegisterCode
		FROM registerhistory
		WHERE WorkstationNodeID=? AND PapoID=?
		ORDER BY ID DESC
	"""

	try:
		result = system.db.runPrepQuery(query, [workstationNodeID,papoID], "papo_db")
		
		regCode = result.getValueAt(0,0)
	except:
		regCode=1

	def insert_answer(registerTypeID, answerJson, regCode):
		if not answerJson:
			return
		query = """
			INSERT INTO registerhistory (
				[Timestamp],
				DataAnswer,
				Status,
				PapoID,
				RegisterTypeID,
				[User],
				WorkstationNodeID,
				NodeID,
				WorkstationID,
				RegisterCode
			)
			VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ? ,?)
		"""
		
		# ⚠️ Aseguramos que sea String plano
		data_answer_str = String(answerJson)
		
		params = [
			now,
			data_answer_str,
			status,
			papoID,
			registerTypeID,
			user,
			workstationNodeID,
			nodeID,
			workstationID,
			regCode
		]
		system.db.runPrepUpdate(query, params, "papo_db")
	
	# --- Insertar directo los tres JSON ---
	insert_answer(7, system.util.jsonEncode(answerIT),regCode)  
	
	
	
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage(
	    messageType="refreshTable", 
	    payload={"estado": True,},
	    scope="session"
	)
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage(
	    messageType="closeEmbeded", 
	    payload={"estado": False,},
	    scope="session"
	)
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage(
	    messageType="refreshPeriodic", 
	    payload={"min": 0,},
	    scope="session"
	)
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshPreviewTable", payload=[], scope="session")
